unit.ants.archer.name: Needler
unit.ants.archer.description: An ant creature bristling with chitin needles that it fires at ground and air targets. Barbed Needles, from the Fungus Garden, makes each hit strip armor. Uses 2 supply.
unit.ants.banneret.name: Herald
unit.ants.banneret.description: Pheromone caster with a crown of golden feathers. Trail speeds allies along the ground, Alarm drives them into a fury, and Panic, learned through Pheromone Mastery, leaves enemies unable to fight. Requires a Great Nest; uses 2 supply.
unit.ants.bombardier.name: Honeypot
unit.ants.bombardier.description: Mutated: a swollen amber replete fused with its carriers. Lobs bursting nectar globs over long range, but cannot fire at anything within 7 units, is slow, and too bloated for the tunnels. Requires a Great Nest; uses 3 supply.
unit.ants.burster.name: Burster
unit.ants.burster.description: Mutated: a huge sloshing sac of liquid substance on legs. It bursts on its first bite, or on command, for heavy damage to enemies and buildings around it, and hurts nearby allies too. Too bloated for the tunnels. Requires a Great Nest; uses 1 supply.
unit.ants.civilian.name: Briarwatch Villager
unit.ants.marshal.name: General
unit.ants.marshal.description: The army-ant marshal, banner on its back and twin blades in hand. Mandible Charge seizes a foe, Mark Prey sets the army on it, War Column drives the march and, at the last, the army locks into a Bivouac.
unit.ants.nectarist.name: Gardener
unit.ants.nectarist.description: Fungus keeper under a wide mushroom cap. Fungus Circle heals the allies standing in it; Spore Cloud, learned through Pheromone Mastery, chokes enemies. Requires a Great Nest; uses 2 supply.
unit.ants.queen.name: The Queen
unit.ants.queen.description: Aurelith, the colony's young queen and the campaign's protagonist, touched by substance. Her Living Light heals an ally or sears an enemy, her Cocoon keeps her from harm, the colony fights as One Body around her and, at the last, she pours raw substance into the fallen for their Rebirth.
unit.ants.queensguard.name: Major
unit.ants.queensguard.description: The colony's armoured tank, with a huge armoured head and a great shield. Guard: small ants beside it take less damage. Plug: it plants its head like a door and holds. Requires a Great Nest; uses 3 supply.
unit.ants.reaver-queen.name: Reaver Queen
unit.ants.reaver-queen.description: Mutated: the colony's ultimate monster. Devours enemies whole, Rampages through their lines, and Molts to heal; nearby ants attack faster in her presence. Ravenous: she starves without prey, Gardeners cannot heal her, and she is too big for the tunnels. Requires the Queen's Chamber; uses 8 supply.
unit.ants.royal-alchemist.name: Royal Alchemist
unit.ants.royal-alchemist.description: Distils substance in her own body. Throws Volatile Draughts, moves life from foe to friend with Transfusion, Crystallises friend or foe and, at the last, drives the army into an Overdose.
unit.ants.settler.name: Worker
unit.ants.settler.description: Gathers amber, builds the colony and, like every ant, travels through the tunnels. Uses 1 supply.
unit.ants.spire-spitter.name: Spire Spitter
unit.ants.spire-spitter.description: The spitter in an ant spire's mouth.
unit.ants.thornblade.name: Bullet Ant
unit.ants.thornblade.description: Elite duellist with a bristling mane, hunting the biggest prey: +15 damage against heroes and large units. Agony: a sting that stuns, then slows and weakens. Requires the Queen's Chamber; uses 3 supply.
unit.ants.venom-spitter.name: Venom Spitter
unit.ants.venom-spitter.description: The spitter in an ant spire's mouth.
unit.ants.warrior.name: Raider
unit.ants.warrior.description: The colony's Zergling: a small, stocky biting ant with blade fins on its back, hatched two at a time. Fast and cheap; Frenzy makes Raiders hit harder the longer they fight together. Uses 1 supply each.
unit.ants.winglancer.name: Alate
unit.ants.winglancer.description: A fast winged ant: scout and light harasser that strikes ground targets from the air. Found: it lands, sheds its wings and becomes a new tunnel mound. Requires a Great Nest; uses 2 supply.
unit.ants.youngling.name: Youngling
unit.beetles.arc-coil.name: Arc Coil
unit.beetles.arc-coil.description: The substance coil of an Arc Tower.
unit.beetles.arcwright.name: Arcwright
unit.beetles.arcwright.description: Specialist with a coil lance. Its arcs jump between enemies; casts Arc Surge, and Static Field after Specialist Training. Requires a Great Bastion; uses 3 supply.
unit.beetles.bolt-turret.name: Bolt Turret
unit.beetles.bolt-turret.description: A brass repeater turret deployed by the Forgemaster. Shoots ground and air units; it runs down after 40 seconds.
unit.beetles.bolt-turret-mk2.name: Bolt Turret Mk II
unit.beetles.bolt-turret-mk2.description: A brass repeater turret deployed by the Forgemaster. Shoots ground and air units; it runs down after 40 seconds.
unit.beetles.bolter.name: Bolter
unit.beetles.bolter.description: Multi-barrel pressure repeater fed from a back canister: rapid bolts against ground and air. Uses 2 supply.
unit.beetles.bombard.name: Bombard
unit.beetles.bombard.description: Six-legged mortar crawler with a crewman. Long-range splash that wrecks clumps and buildings, but it cannot fire at anything within 7 units. Requires a Great Bastion; uses 3 supply.
unit.beetles.breacher.name: Breacher
unit.beetles.breacher.description: Siege drill arm and clamp. Breaks buildings and armor, and charges in from range. Every strike cracks armor. Requires a Great Bastion; uses 3 supply.
unit.beetles.coilkeeper.name: Coilkeeper
unit.beetles.coilkeeper.description: Substance savant with a coil halo and a lantern-staff. Lashes enemies with chained lightning, Overloads their mana, Recharges allies and, once, lets the substance loose: Unbottled.
unit.beetles.forgemaster.name: Forgemaster
unit.beetles.forgemaster.description: Engineer hero with a smokestack helm and a back arm rig. Deploys Bolt Turrets, Overclocks allies, keeps a Field Forge burning around him and calls down Forgefall.
unit.beetles.hornbreaker.name: Hornbreaker
unit.beetles.hornbreaker.description: Beetle warlord with a Hercules horn and a great hammer. Charges into battle, overwhelms a chosen enemy, steadies nearby allies and becomes a Colossus.
unit.beetles.hornwatch-gunner.name: Hornwatch Gunner
unit.beetles.hornwatch-gunner.descriptio: The repeater crew of a Hornwatch.
unit.beetles.juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
unit.beetles.juggernaut.description: Ultimate walking fortress: six legs, a violet furnace window, two cannons and a crew. Fires Broadside; Furnace Plating turns aside 30% of spell damage. Requires an Elder Bastion; uses 8 supply.
unit.beetles.mender.name: Mender
unit.beetles.mender.description: Field medic with a pressure syringe-gun and a welding torch. Mends beetles and machines; Field Repair after Specialist Training. Requires a Great Bastion; uses 2 supply.
unit.beetles.shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
unit.beetles.shieldbearer.description: Front-line tank behind a riveted tower shield, swinging a piston hammer. Lock Shields braces it in place for heavy armor. Slow and stubborn; uses 2 supply.
unit.beetles.steamwing.name: Steamwing
unit.beetles.steamwing.description: Boiler-winged flyer: a scout and anti-air harasser whose chin emitter fires violet bolts at ground and air. Flak Beam adds damage against flyers. Requires a Great Bastion; uses 3 supply.
unit.beetles.supply-cart.name: Supply Cart
unit.beetles.supply-cart.description: A draft beetle hauling glass tanks of substance along the beetles' roads. Slow, sturdy and unarmed; whoever breaks one takes the amber it carries.
unit.beetles.warden.name: Warden
unit.beetles.warden.description: Carries a barrier projector: a curved violet pane that stops enemy missiles and shells from the front. Bulwark Pulse after Specialist Training. Requires a Great Bastion; uses 3 supply.
unit.beetles.worker.name: Tinker
unit.beetles.worker.description: Gathers amber, builds and repairs beetle buildings, and patches machines with Patch Up. Uses 1 supply.
